Shreya Shah
Financial Analyst | Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
shreya.shah377@example.com | +91 9714597102

Analytical and detail-oriented Financial Analyst with a focus on FP&A and IFRS-compliant reporting. Skilled at building financial models and dashboards in Microsoft Excel to inform strategic decisions and improve forecasting accuracy. Comfortable working in collaborative, Agile environments and using version control for financial models.

Experience
Bluefin Logistics — Oct 2024 - Present
Financial Analyst (Hybrid)
- Built and maintained rolling 12-month FP&A models in Microsoft Excel, reducing forecast variance from 12% to 5% within two quarters through scenario analysis and driver-based assumptions (Financial Modeling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel).
- Led IFRS-aligned monthly close reconciliations and prepared three consolidated financial statements, shortening close cycle by 2 days while ensuring compliance (IFRS, Microsoft Excel).
- Implemented version-controlled financial model templates using Git and documented model changes to improve auditability and enable quicker peer reviews (Financial Modeling, Git, Microsoft Excel).
- Collaborated with operations to translate shipment and pricing changes into cash flow projections, improving working capital forecast accuracy by 18% (FP&A, Financial Modeling).

Wipro — Jun 2023 - Sep 2024
Financial Analyst (Onsite)
- Developed quarterly IFRS-compliant financial models for service line profitability, enabling management to reallocate budget and increase high-margin projects by 9% (IFRS, Financial Modeling).
- Automated Excel-based FP&A reporting, creating macros and standardized templates that reduced report preparation time by 40% and improved data consistency (Microsoft Excel, FP&A).
- Performed variance analysis and presented actionable insights to senior stakeholders, driving a 6% reduction in controllable operating expenses across assigned portfolios (FP&A, Microsoft Excel).
- Managed model versioning and handoffs using Git workflows and participated in Agile sprint reviews to prioritize financial deliverables (Git, Agile).

Projects
- Cash Flow Sensitivity Tool — Built an Excel-based scenario tool to model cash flow impacts of rate changes and delayed receivables, which was used to support short-term treasury decisions (Financial Modeling, Microsoft Excel).
- IFRS Transition Checklist — Created a documented checklist and reconciliations for month-end IFRS adjustments to streamline reviewer sign-off and reduce rework during audits (IFRS, Microsoft Excel).

Skills
Financial Modeling: Financial Modeling, Microsoft Excel
FP&A & Reporting: FP&A, IFRS
